_source: Plain-language summaries of each boon tag, shown as hover tooltips wherever a tag appears. Not rules: written from the boons in docs/design-bible.md. Edit freely.

tags.Core: Steady, simple boons any character can draft, like speed, initiative or resistances. They don't evolve or fuse, and don't count for Resonance.
tags.Echo: Hits that repeat. Echo boons bounce part of your damage onto the same target again or onto nearby enemies.
tags.Reaper: Rewards finishing enemies off. Kills and hits on Bloodied creatures fuel teleports, bonus damage and stored souls.
tags.Spell: For spellcasters. Boosts leveled spells and cantrips, concentration, and what happens when a creature fails a save against your spell.
tags.Crit: Built around critical hits: wider crit ranges, rerolls and trade-offs that change how often and how hard you crit.
tags.Stance: Plant your feet. Stance boons trade movement for defense or power by anchoring in place or squaring off against groups.
tags.Volley: Ranged attackers. Ricochets, multi-target shots, ignoring cover and elemental arrows.
tags.Shadow: Stealth and tricks. Hiding, teleporting, striking first, and handling room tricks and traps.
tags.Rally: Support your allies with temp HP, bonus dice, damage boosts and battle standards.
tags.Guard: Tanking and healing. Reduce damage, punish attackers, and make your heals stronger.
tags.Bond: For characters with a summon, familiar or companion. Share damage, swap places and fight as a pair.
tags.Flurry: Many small hits. Flurry boons grow stronger with each extra hit you land in a turn.
tags.Blood: Power from pain. Stronger while Bloodied, or spend your own HP for extra damage.
tags.Hunt: Big-game hunting. Mark, study and punish bosses and Large or larger creatures.
tags.Payoff: Reads from a stat track, so it grows as that track ranks up. Only offered once you have a rank in its track. Doesn't evolve, fuse or count for Resonance.
